Podcast

At MOR Radio, staying connected with you means everything to us. Whether you’re a loyal listener, a curious first-timer, or one of our passionate presenters, we believe that every connection creates a ripple of impact. Our mission is to build a vibrant community of faith, inspiration, and transformation, and that starts with open communication.

Weekday Schedule

Morning Inspiration

African gospel music, motivational quotes, and prayers.

Featured segment: “Daily Proverbs” – African wisdom for the day.

Local traffic and weather reports.

Special interviews with African personalities and community leaders.

A mix of the latest Afrobeat hits, Amapiano, and Afropop.

Audience call-ins to share song requests or dedications.

Business & Development Hour

Discussions on entrepreneurship, investment opportunities in Africa, and Diaspora success stories.

Weekly guest speakers: African entrepreneurs, business experts, and thought leaders.

High-energy DJ mixes featuring classic African hits and international tunes.Light-hearted conversations, jokes, and trivia competitions.

watch now

Culture & Heritage Show

Focus on African traditions, languages, and cuisines.Interviews with historians, chefs, and cultural ambassadors.

Weekly storytelling segment: “Tales from the Motherland.”
